data.content: Planning complete. All trust must originate in live provider readback; plain Git and tracked content cannot self-attest. Dependencies are knots-2af8, knots-c472, knots-74e2, and knots-9b6a. Live disposable probes and fail-closed race/mismatch tests are required. Existing approval covers all provider, SQLite, GitHub, and Diffinite work; preserve all historical objects indefinitely.
